name: Lentils (Green)
siboNotes: High in galactans which feed bacteria in SIBO. Start with very small portions (1-2 tablespoons) if tolerated during maintenance phase only.
preparationTips: Soak overnight and rinse thoroughly before cooking to reduce some galactans
Cook until very soft to improve digestibility
Start with red lentils which may be slightly better tolerated
Combine with digestive spices like ginger, cumin, or fennel seeds
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of iron and potassium
